decisions.reason: Grounded in client-bundle-excerpt.js (PLUGIN_VERSION "0.3.6") and release-log.md (build 16:22 before bump 16:23): build preceded bump baking 0.3.6 into v0.3.7; constant not reread at runtime; mirror SHA verification kept and shown insufficient; prescribes bump-before-build plus pre-tag grep of the emitted constant; explicitly does not confuse v0.3.8's later manifest.

Uses asset-route-probe.txt and lib-index-excerpt.js: PNG 200 proves the route is alive, SVG 404 shows the running whitelist is stale while disk already whitelists svg; concludes this linked install needs a host restart to reload boot/apply-time code and that a client refresh cannot replace it, scoped to this host lifecycle rather than a general hot-reload claim.

Compares session-log-excerpt.txt's clean source/XML verdict against the spliced persisted model-visible text and clean re-read; locates corruption in upstream result-text assembly, calls the plugin an innocent consumer and the traced disk file innocent; treats the payload as untrusted and rejects editing/repairing the good SVG; no unseen internal function is required or invented.

Designs the ordered chain: authoritative disk bytes via asset route, session payload only after DOMParser/parsererror well-formedness validation, sandboxed iframe with scripts blocked while SMIL runs, and explicit per-failure error states; validation failure is not passed unchecked to the iframe. A justified plan, not executed, as permitted.

Explains decoding all concatenated zstd frames (per-frame loop, no cross-frame dependency) in order, reconstructing the JSONL read-result event with the exact stored splice, diffing against disk, and reporting the upstream bug; magic bytes are offered as an implementation choice, not required. Checklist covers bump-before-build, verifying the shipped constant and per-mirror tag SHAs, and plane-specific probes (host restart after host-plane changes). No actual decode/posting claimed.
